newsitem.title: CANADA: Seaway Authority drops late transit fine to Dec 25.
newsitem.headline: Seaway Authority drops late transit fine to Dec 25.

text.p: Fines on ships reporting late at points of call throughout the St. Lawrence Seaway due to begin on Friday were deferred to Christmas day, a St. Lawrence Seaway Authority spokeswoman said.

"We waived our late clearance fines because the weather's good and there's no ice in the system. Ships can transit without fines until the 24th," Authority spokeswoman Sylvie Moncion told Reuters in French.
The Seaway should close by Dec 26 or 27, she said.
There were 29 vessels in transit between ports on Lake Erie and St. Lambert at 0700 EST/1200 GMT Friday, she said.
St. Lambert is at the eastern end of the Seaway.
Late transit fines come into effect at 0001 EST/0501 GMT Dec 25, she said.
